performance.statement: not predicted: no performance model is calibrated for this backend yet; the ordering below rests on measured relative speeds, not on a time estimate

load_bound.available_at_plan_source: cgroup v1: limit - usage + reclaimable page cache (21.1 GiB of it is page cache)
load_bound.basis: inferred bound: host estimate + checkpoint weight files on disk; not measured, graded per receipt

reasons: experts4bit: vram_gb sized to 3.375, the largest the device budget allows
experts4bit: dram_gb sized to 3.375, the largest the host budget allows
all experts resident (placement all-vram): 7.06 GiB estimated + 1.18 GiB headroom fits the 23.63 GiB budget
KV pool 0.27 GiB for 1 sequences x 4096 tokens; it scales linearly in both
kernels: paged FP8 KV pool + attention, fp8 compute; grouped NF4 / int4 decode routes as serve_paged resolves them (reported at /health)
ordering, graphs: decode graphs before eager decode: serve_paged's own default for all-VRAM placement on CUDA (_graphs_env); the graph pools are listed as not modelled

decode-graph buckets [1]: none above 1 sequences, since a step never carries more rows than sequences; each bucket costs a graph, and the largest sizes the scratch slots (per-slot state on a hybrid model)

first-chunk prefill graph off (the server's default is auto): its private pool is not priced (SV1 measured +0.56 GiB at Qwen3-30B with NF4 experts), so the plan's memory would not bound the process; fix prefill_graph=auto to let the server engage it when that much is free
int4 levers off: exp_int4 and attn_int4 change the served weights (round-to-nearest int4), so the planner prices them only when fixed

single stream: the B=1 fused stack (fused q/k/v and three glue folds) is off by default for olmoe: no registered read; setting its knobs to auto applies it where the structure matches, without that read
not planned yet: a measured routing profile for the solver; decode speed beyond a receipt of this same setup (see performance)

to serve it: E4B_PAGED_BUCKETS=1 E4B_PAGED_BULK_KV=1 E4B_PAGED_CHUNK_TOKENS=512 E4B_PAGED_DRAM_GB=6.0 E4B_PAGED_GRAPHS=1 E4B_PAGED_HOT_ROWS=64 E4B_PAGED_KV_GROUPS=auto E4B_PAGED_MAX_SEQS=1 E4B_PAGED_MAX_TOKENS_PER_SEQ=4096 E4B_PAGED_PLACEMENT=all-vram E4B_PAGED_PREFILL_GRAPH=0 E4B_PAGED_VRAM_GB=1.2 E4B_SERVE_ATTN_INT4=0 E4B_SERVE_EXP_INT4=0 python -m experts4bit_qlora.serve_paged (with the model's arena and calibration)
estimate evidence: no overhead term measured on this machine yet; CUDA context, allocator reserve, host baseline defaults (each line above names its receipt or default)
